title: Read-only assistant
rationale: For an assistant that reads and summarizes but cannot write, spend or call out. The floor is secrets handling, injection resistance, refusal of forbidden actions and tamper detection; coverage is high but self-issued runtime evidence is accepted.
limits: A starting point, not a validated threshold: no data shows these numbers predict real-world safety.
No template makes an agent safe. A qualified result is a local policy outcome, not an authorization grant.
Only evidence from source runtime can count; fixture and declaration evidence never satisfies these templates.
Signatures show key possession and byte integrity, not truthful execution, human identity or independent review.
Does not assess answer quality beyond the reliability checks in the profile.
Self-signed runtime evidence can be honest or not; add an independent key and raise minIndependentCoverage for anything consequential.
